### Manual test plan for Story 6.1: Apply MagicCraft Theme

- Environment
  - Test both Popup and Full app views.
  - Browsers: Chrome (primary), Firefox (sanity).
  - Clear localStorage before start.

### Setup
1. Clear theme state: open DevTools Console and run `localStorage.removeItem('theme:magic')`.
2. Open Settings → General. Toggle “Enable MagicCraft theme” on and off during tests.
3. Reload after toggling on to verify persistence.

### AC1: Color palette applied across main UI surfaces
- Background
  - Open any main screen (Dashboard/Popup). In DevTools, inspect `html, body` and verify:
    - Background color computed ≈ `#1A1B2F` (Midnight Blue).
    - Text color computed is white.
- Cards/Panels
  - On main content areas, verify elements have `magic-card` class:
    - Rounded corners, subtle border, translucent surface, light blur.
- Buttons
  - Find a primary action using `Button` with `theme="magic"` (e.g., anywhere the magic button is used).
  - Hover state shows glow with Gold accent `#F1C40F`; focus state has visible focus ring.
- Accents
  - Check headings using `magic-heading` and any `.gold` accent text where present.

Pass if: Midnight Blue background and white primary text are consistent; cards and buttons show MagicCraft styling.

### AC2: Spellbook visual touches present on main screens
- Parchment surfaces
  - Verify parchment-like background on layouts using `magic-page bg-magic-parchment` (visible textured/parchment look).
- Rounded parchment panels
  - Cards/panels visually appear parchment-like with rounded corners (`magic-card`).
- Glowing hover effects
  - Hover over magic-themed buttons; confirm subtle lift and glow.
- Rune-like icons
  - Scan toolbar/icons for any rune-like styling. If not present, record as gap.

Pass if: parchment background is visible, cards are rounded parchment style, hover glow is present. Note rune-like iconography if absent.

### Theming toggle behavior (Settings → General)
1. Toggle ON: The document root gets `magic` class; theme is visibly applied.
2. Reload: `localStorage.getItem('theme:magic') === "1"` and theme remains applied.
3. Toggle OFF: Root `magic` class removed.
   - Known limitation: many `magic-*` classes are explicit, so theme may remain largely applied. Record as expected current behavior.

Pass if: toggle persists and adds/removes root class; note partial off behavior as acceptable for now.

### Screens to cover
- Onboarding flow
  - `Welcome`, `AddAccountInitial`, and subsequent steps use `BoardingPageLayout` with `magic-page` and parchment background.
- Dashboard/Main page
  - Verify `MainPageLayout` uses `magic-page` and `magic-card` on content.
- Popup UI
  - Verify `PopupLayout` has `magic-page` container and content `magic-card`.

Pass if: all three areas show consistent theme surfaces.

### Assets and branding
- Title and logo
  - Confirm app title “MagicCraft” appears where applicable and the header/logo updates where used.
- Favicon
  - In both main and approve windows, tab icon uses `/icons/magiccraft/favicon.ico`.

Pass if: favicon is MagicCraft in both windows.

### Accessibility basics
- Contrast
  - Use Chrome DevTools Accessibility pane or Lighthouse to spot-check text on background and on cards; ensure no “low contrast” flags for primary text.
- Focus visibility
  - Tab through interactive elements; focus ring clearly visible on magic buttons.

Pass if: no major contrast violations and focus is visible.

### Visual regression quick checks
- Take screenshots for:
  - Welcome/Onboarding (first step)
  - Dashboard/Main page
  - Popup home
- Compare that parchment/bg and card styling are consistent and no regressions in spacing/legibility.

### Known risks to note during testing
- Token coverage
  - If `bg-magic-parchment`, `bg-surface-card`, `border-surface-border` are missing in some views, note which views are affected.
- Rune-like icons
  - If none exist, record as AC2 partial.

If you want, I can create a lightweight checklist in the repo for QA to mark pass/fail per screen and attach screenshots.
